_comment: The routes make check-layout accepts failing at 320px or at 200% text, as route -> check ids: scroll-320, text-320, scroll-200, text-200. A check that is not listed fails the gate; a check listed that no longer fires fails it too, so this file can only shrink. Each storefront page change removes its routes, and a route added later is measured with nothing listed. The run prints the file that makes it green when the set moves.
